masteryZone.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the 7 SI base units?
masteryZone.sol: Radian is a supplementary unit, not one of the 7 base units (Meter, Kilogram, Second, Ampere, Kelvin, Mole, Candela).

masteryZone.q: True or False: The mole was officially added to the SI system as a base unit in 1971.
masteryZone.sol: True. The mole was adopted as the 7th base unit in 1971 by the 14th CGPM.

masteryZone.q: Which unit is used to express the thickness of white dwarf mass limits?
masteryZone.sol: The Chandrasekhar Limit is a unit of mass, equal to 1.4 solar masses, representing the white dwarf stability limit.
1 Parsec is approximately equal to 3.26 light years.

masteryZone.q: What is the dimensional formula of Work or Energy?
What is the SI derived unit of electrical resistance?
Which instrument is used to measure the growth of plants?
masteryZone.sol: The Crescograph is used to measure growth in plants, invented by J.C. Bose.

masteryZone.q: True or False: A hydrometer is used to measure humidity in the atmosphere.
masteryZone.sol: False. A hydrometer measures relative density of liquids. A hygrometer measures humidity.

masteryZone.q: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
masteryZone.sol: Force is a vector because it has direction and obeys vector addition laws. Current, Power, and Work are scalars.

masteryZone.q: True or False: A vector quantity has both magnitude and direction, and must follow vector addition laws.
masteryZone.sol: True. Direction and magnitude alone are not enough; following vector laws (like triangle law) is mandatory.
